assets.description: 后台同一演员指空木铃架，请面对面的伙伴帮忙，眼神着急又礼貌 The same early-grade actor appears in the first four cells: short dark bob, simple terracotta sweater and ivory shirt. Two people are visible in this cell. Make the pointing actor the focus and leave the wooden hook visibly empty.

同一小演员正在收好纸偶，用空手指向门旁另一伙伴 Same short-dark-bob terracotta-sweater actor, holding one small flat paper puppet in one hand, the other hand pointing to a distinct friend at the doorway. Pose is calm and matter-of-fact.

assets.description: 同一演员掀开一小角蓝布，探头露出惊奇，露出半只木铃 Same actor, eyes open and leaning in, lifting just one corner of a mid-blue stage curtain. Show only part of the small wooden bell behind the curtain; the actor has not taken it out.
同一演员举起木铃，笑容轻快，蓝布安静放在一旁 Same actor visibly smiling with a lifted arm holding the whole small wooden bell. The blue curtain is at rest and no longer hides the bell.

一面火红小纸彩旗在木棒上，同样淡奶油底，无符号 Exactly one fire-red unmarked triangular pennant attached to a slim wooden dowel, centered; no symbol or text.
